findings.evidence: template/scripts/independent_review.py:704 calls independent_review_runner.preflight(root) without a bound launcher, and lines 705–715 check the scratch-HOME login only if that first probe succeeds. independent_review_runner.py:486 uses the default subprocess_launcher, whose Popen at lines 110–112 receives env=None. Thus an operator with a valid declared token_file but no ambient CLI login gets ready=false before the binding is used, although the worker's review launcher uses llm_env and can authenticate. The readiness probe must use the same scratch HOME and provider-bound environment to reflect worker readiness.
findings.summary: Standalone preflight can reject a working token binding because its model readiness probe uses the ambient environment.
